gatedWork.reason: WCNCP-009 requires at least three actionable material families before WCNCP-010. Only GraphQL Java qualifies, so WCNCP-010 through WCNCP-012 were never authorized.

provenBoundary: The ordinary Gradle-wrapper coordination, observation, shared state, validation orchestration, and reviewed-artifact system is functionally proven, but the frozen ten-family prospective cohort yields only one actionable material native correction. This experiment therefore does not establish sufficient opportunity breadth or product value.
nextResearchBoundary: A future experiment must introduce a prospectively frozen, source-neutral detector or cohort hypothesis that can plausibly yield at least three actionable material families. It may not rerun these rows, lower the 500 ms or 2 percent materiality gates, treat unsupported external blockers as actionable, or start candidate/value work from this stopped cohort.
